duration_s.principle: Standard methodology field; unrolling and Q-head training take real wall-clock.

field_principles.duration_s: Standard methodology field; unrolling and Q-head training take real wall-clock.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Standard methodology field; names the actual latent-unrolling substrate used.
field_principles.n_heldout_trajectories: Sample sizes; AUROC needs N>=30 per side (CLT) and the split must be honest.
field_principles.n_train_trajectories: Sample sizes; AUROC needs N>=30 per side (CLT) and the split must be honest.
field_principles.per_step_calibration_curve: Per-step held-out Q-head score means for correct and incorrect trajectories; this is the calibration curve requested for the prototype.
field_principles.per_step_calibration_monotonic: Whether Q_head(h_t) rises toward correct trajectories with t -- the property that makes it a usable continuous internal halt signal.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Standard methodology field; records torch, headroom, corpus, and recursive-refiner source gates before unrolling and training.
field_principles.qhead_ablated_auroc: AUROC with test-time-compute/identity-conditioning ablated; guards the 2512.11847 crutch -- the moat must be the Q-head, not voting.
field_principles.qhead_heldout_auroc: The distilled Q-head's predictive AUROC on held-out trajectories -- the core feasibility metric for the offline-distillation pivot.
field_principles.random_seed: Standard methodology field; deterministic split, training, and reproducibility.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Standard methodology field; catches silent source, data, or metric drift.
field_principles.verifier_oracle_label_source: Which verifier produced the distillation labels -- the audit trail back to a real measurement in the offline-oracle role.
